outcome: labor induction duration (initiation to active phase)
total duration of labor induction to vaginal delivery
cohort: The study included 60 full-term nulliparous pregnant women, between 39-42 weeks gestation, undergoing induction of labor.
finding: Intravenous dexamethasone significantly shortened the time from labor induction to the active phase and the total duration from labor induction to vaginal delivery compared to vaginal misoprostol.
mod_finding: The rate of successful vaginal delivery was higher in the dexamethasone group but not statistically significantly different from the misoprostol group.
